title: Scheduling: Workflows, the AI Assistant and Deployment | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Appointments rarely stand alone: customers need an email, an assistant can take bookings in chat, and a second site needs the same setup. The Scheduling module for Orchard Core connects to workflows, to the AI tools of CrestApps, and to deployment plans.

This video shows each of them on screen, and what to check when times or booking pages don't appear.

In this video:
• Workflows: the Scheduling events and tasks in the editor
• The AI assistant: the Scheduling tools of an AI profile, and what customers can ask
• Copying scheduling to another site with a deployment plan
• Troubleshooting: no times, a missing booking page, staff on shifts
